✨✨✨ Our 2027 Wellness Retreats are now open✨✨✨  
  
It is an absolute privilege to lead an organization that serves women and girls of the global majority. Our retreat season through my org @she\_imprints is officially here! Allow us to hold you in sacred space across all seasons. Join us in:   
  
✨ Panama during the week of Juneteenth  
✨ Ease into fall with us in Marrakech, Morocco  
✨ (for ladies in Ohio) Join us for a restorative weekend in Hocking Hills [...] ✨ close out the 2027 New Year with us on a private island in Belize (December 2027)  
✨ (for ladies in Columbus) join us this December 5 - 6 for a 2 day wellness experience at Homeostasis   
  
Links in bio to apply. Or, join our mailing list for updates. All of our retreats have limited space and Morocco is almost sold out!  
  
Come away with us to return to you.  
  
Join us Juneteenth week in Panama for restorative retreat [...] Join us in Morocco to awaken love, joy and pleasure in the fall  
  
Join us for a weekend getaway if you’re in Ohio  
  
End the year with us in Belize  
  
End 2026 with us in Columbus Ohio for 2 day wellness experience for women of color leaders

This retreat is so much more than a vacation at a luxury villa. It’s an opportunity to reconnect with yourself in one of the most beautiful places in the world surrounded by women who are also choosing growth, alignment, healing, and expansion.  
  
August 17–22, 2026  
Villa Punto de Vista 🌴  
(The stunning sister property next door to the villa where my previous retreats were held) [...] Daily movement, sound healing, transformational workshops, excursions, incredible private chef meals, a curated beach day, sunset sailing, deep connection, an intimate Messages from Above event, and memories that will stay with you forever.  
  
And with no Costa Rica retreat planned for 2027…this is truly your last chance for the foreseeable future.  
  
Only TWO spots remain ♥️  
Link in bio for more info.   
DM me with any questions. [...] And it’s not just me who has experienced deep transformation through these retreats. So many of the women who’ve joined us have gone on to make beautiful, life-changing shifts after their time in Costa Rica.
